text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One morning, when I get to my office,<n>Mejiro Dober
is already there waiting<n>for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-no I'm not. This is a perfectly<n>normal time to be
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the new essential oil I bought<n>was really
effective, so I slept well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Actually, aren't you just late? Areyou getting enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: How are you? Are you getting<n>enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You should at least try to sleep more<n>on your days
off. Use essential oils to<n>help you or something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's good... I still worry about you,<n>though, since
you're always pushing<n>yourself so hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm just warning you. I'd be<n>negatively impacted
too if something<n>happened to you, so you'd better
watch yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I should be the one saying that. If<n>you'd like, I can
recommend you<n>some essential oils.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I should follow Mejiro Dober's<n>example and get
more rest.
